react-error-boundary import.description:
Import ErrorBoundary from react-error-boundary 6.

从 react-error-boundary 6 导入 ErrorBoundary。

body: const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unexpected error';
react-error-boundary complete component.description:
Complete TypeScript React error boundary with an accessible fallback and reset action. Requires react-error-boundary 6.

带无障碍降级 UI 和重置操作的完整 TypeScript React 错误边界；需要 react-error-boundary 6。

body: const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unexpected error';
react-error-boundary complete component.description:
Complete JavaScript React error boundary with an accessible fallback and reset action. Requires react-error-boundary 6.

带无障碍降级 UI 和重置操作的完整 JavaScript React 错误边界；需要 react-error-boundary 6。

react-error-boundary fallback render Jav.description:
Create a fallbackRender callback for an ErrorBoundary. Pass it as <ErrorBoundary fallbackRender={fallbackRender}>; requires ErrorBoundary from react-error-boundary.

创建 ErrorBoundary 的 fallbackRender 回调；将它传入 <ErrorBoundary fallbackRender={fallbackRender}>，需要从 react-error-boundary 导入 ErrorBoundary。

react-error-boundary fallback render Typ.description:
Create a typed fallbackRender callback for an ErrorBoundary. Separately import type { FallbackProps } from 'react-error-boundary', then pass it as <ErrorBoundary fallbackRender={fallbackRender}>.

创建带类型的 ErrorBoundary fallbackRender 回调；需单独从 react-error-boundary 导入 type { FallbackProps }，再通过 <ErrorBoundary fallbackRender={fallbackRender}> 传入。

react-error-boundary reset keys.description:
Create reset options for an ErrorBoundary. Spread them as <ErrorBoundary {...boundaryOptions}>; reset keys can also clear related state in onReset.

创建 ErrorBoundary 的重置选项；通过 <ErrorBoundary {...boundaryOptions}> 传入，reset key 也可在 onReset 中清理关联状态。

react-error-boundary async showBoundary.description:
Forward an async event-handler failure to the nearest boundary. Requires useErrorBoundary from react-error-boundary and a surrounding ErrorBoundary.

将异步事件处理器失败交给最近的错误边界；需要从 react-error-boundary 导入 useErrorBoundary，并有外层 ErrorBoundary。
